name: ui-steps
description: A page-record steps file that drives a component through its interactions, written from a recording of the component's idle state. Never sees the component's code.

verbs.name: write
verbs.description: Write the states to drive a component through, in one model call, from a page-record recording of its idle state. Keeps the recording's url, target, viewport, and colorScheme, puts idle first, and adds 2 to 4 interaction states. Pass the error the last steps hit to revise them. Cached by every input's content, the model, and the prompt hash.

recording.description: recording.json of a page-record capture of the component's idle state. Its steps file is read too.

problem.description: Free text, such as the page-record error the last steps hit.
